title: Accessibility before a single rescue logged in.
description: The accessibility work on AdoptDontShop before its beta: checks on every change, button contrast, screen-reader names, focus outlines and reduced motion.
lede: No rescue has used AdoptDontShop yet. We still spent September to November on accessibility. This is what we did, in order. It is work done, not a claim of compliance.
summary: From automated checks on every change to button contrast, screen-reader names, focus outlines and reduced motion: the accessibility work on AdoptDontShop before its beta.
